messages:
elaine: Heads-up: after the route-alias rollout, some tenants' invoice previews show higher per-token rates. Not widespread but enough to worry product.

omar: saw a couple of examples. It looks like the billing transform applied per-route multipliers using route_id, but the route aliases introduced on the edge map to different pricing labels.

yuki: quick summary: we introduced route_aliases so customers can route to 'nlp-fast' which maps to rt-123 or rt-456. The pricing mapping was keyed by route_id, not alias. When alias->route mapping changed, the multiplier lookup returned default (higher) rate for a short window.

elaine: so pricing is computed at ingest/enrichment time using the current route_id. That means if alias resolution changes later, invoice previews might diverge from final billing which recomputes using latest mapping.

billing-bot: [auto] Created ticket BILL-824 for discrepant price-mapping logic; linked example tenant ids 9001,9002.

omar: we have two architectural choices: (A) compute and persist final pricing label at ingestion (stable but requires producer changes), or (B) compute pricing at billing job time using authoritative alias->price map (consistent but requires billing to rehydrate route mapping history).

yuki: tradeoffs: (A) means every ingest event carries price_label, simplifies later pipeline, but if pricing rules change retroactively we can't apply them without backfills. (B) allows latest pricing to be applied but needs richer audit logs and makes invoice-preview less accurate until billing job runs.

paul: from product POV, invoice previews in Console should match final invoices as closely as possible. We can't have previews misleading customers. Which approach gives us better UX?

elaine: hybrid idea: persist both - price_label_at_ingest and route_alias_id. Invoices computed by default from billing job (authoritative), but Console preview can choose which source to use. Add a Console toggle: Preview mode = 'as-ingested' vs 'billing-computed'. That helps CS debug.

billing-bot: cost/ops estimate: dual persistence increases event payload ~+40 bytes -> about +0.6% storage. Billing job changes estimated 3 engineer-days to support alias history lookups.

yuki: telemetry needs: add metrics billing.price.delta_percent_preview_vs_final, metering.route_alias.flip_count, billing.price_resolution.latency. Dashboards should surface tenants with >10% delta.

omar: rollout plan suggestion:
- quick patch producers to include route_alias_id and price_label_at_ingest (dual emit)
- add billing job support to read route_alias history (can be toggled per-tenant)
- Console: add Preview toggle and a per-tenant warning if preview != final in last 7 days
- run canary on 1% tenants for 48h

paul: good. Also need a CS communication template explaining "Why preview may change" and an opt-in to use "billing-computed" previews for enterprise customers.

elaine: one gotcha: some downstream analytics customers ingest price_label_at_ingest for their chargeback. Dual emitting will create duplicate fields for them. We need to notify integrators and tag the new field price_label_v2.

billing-bot: action items assigned: BILL-824 (engineers), CONS-410 (Console toggle), CS-122 (customer note).

yuki: set an alert: if billing.price.delta_percent_preview_vs_final > 15% for >10 tenants in 1h, pause alias mapping changes and page oncall.

omar: also, add a short-lived mitigation: if we detect alias->route churn > threshold, billing job should fallback to price_label_at_ingest to avoid big swings.

paul: timeline: engineers ok to ship producer dual-emit by EOD tomorrow, billing changes in one sprint. CS wants the preview toggle in Console before broad rollout.

elaine: I'll open the PR and the Console ticket, schedule sync with billing team tomorrow 10:30. Thanks all.
